title: Above-ground biomass regression from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 monthly series (BioMassters)

windows.period: September of the year before the label to August of the label year

time.comparison_rule: PANGAEA: all 12 months, missing months zero-filled and not masked

s2.notes: The dataset already provides the least cloudy image per month (chosen with the CLP mask). A month with no file is marked invalid. CLP is scaled differently from the reflectance bands (scale 1).

s1_asc.notes: Channels 1–2 of each S1 file. Monthly mean of all acquisitions; values below −25 dB masked by the dataset authors.

target.label_source: airborne LiDAR calibrated with field plots, converted to AGB by allometric equations (Finnish Forest Centre), originally on a 16 m grid

official.definition: Test: 30% of chips from 2018, 2020 and 2021 and 20% from 2019, chosen at random; all 2017 chips in train (Nascetti et al. 2023). The original release has no validation split; EOArena draws 20% of training chips at random, stratified by year (our choice).

extra_tests.name: later-year
extra_tests.definition: Train on chips labelled 2017–2020, test on 2021 chips.

extra_tests.name: out-of-region
extra_tests.definition: Spatial blocks, if chip locations can be recovered; GEO-Bench-2 reports merging location from a metadata table.

primary_metric.name: RMSE
primary_metric.averaging: RMSE per chip, averaged over test chips; zero-biomass pixels included (competition rule)

evaluation.inference: whole 256 × 256 chip; adapters tile or upsample per protocols.json

harness: PANGAEA's config has placeholder zeros for mean and std (marked TODO).
PANGAEA replaces S1 no-data (−9999) with 0 and fills missing months with zeros; its temporal mask is always false, so neither is flagged.
PANGAEA reports the square root of the batch-averaged MSE, not the competition's per-chip averaged RMSE.
GEO-Bench-2 uses 7 time steps (selection not stated), z-scores the labels, and uses S1 only for TerraMind.
open_questions: Does label 0 mean zero biomass only (paper) or also missing data (competition page)? This decides whether 0 is a nodata value.
The paper states AGB in tonnes per pixel but also uses t/ha. Confirm the unit before publishing results.
